Sam (support): FYI — multiple customers reporting p99 spikes on /v1/generate for rwd-large-2, started ~15m ago. Example request-id: req_9f3a. Getting 502s and tail latency 3-6s. Any known incidents?

Mia (eng-runtime): Looking. Can you dump a couple of request IDs and sample payload sizes? Are these long chat histories (KV cache growth)?

Sam (support): Sent 3 request-ids in DM. Short payloads (~1-2k tokens) but some experiments with long-history chat sessions. One customer said perf regressed after yesterday's runtime push.

Raj (eng-sre): Grafana heatmap shows per-GPU resident set climbing; p99 latency correlates with GPU memory high-water and allocator stalls. KV cache size metric for those sessions is spiking. Heatmap: https://grafana.internal/g/xx/kv-heatmap :eyes:

Mia (eng-runtime): Confirmed. Logs show repeated OOM-retry and slower allocations; allocator fragmentation increasing. Snippet from worker logs:
```
2026-03-17 13:02:34 worker-7 WARN allocator: slow_free 122ms, free_frag=0.78
2026-03-17 13:03:01 rpc: Requeue request req_9f3a due to backpressure
```

Elena (eng-ml): This smells like KV growth + long-lived sessions where we keep full KV for many sequences. We can try trimming old KV entries, reduce KV retention TTL, or enable per-session cap.

Mia (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigations: 1) route heavy chat sessions to fallback quantized model rwd-large-2-q8 that reduces memory. 2) Apply soft cap on per-session KV tokens -> drop oldest when > 32k tokens. 3) Enforce smaller max_batch for affected shards. I'll push an operator patch to routing policy. @Raj fyi.

Raj (eng-sre): I'll scale up node pool + drain most fragmented nodes for quick restart. Starting node drain on node-gpu-12.

deploy-bot: Started drain of node-gpu-12, migrating 42 active pods, est 6m.

Mia (eng-runtime): Patch ready — routing rule: if session_kv_size > 200MB OR avg_alloc_wait > 20ms route to rwd-large-2-q8 and set max_batch=4. Pushing canary to 10%.

ops-bot: Canary rollout succeeded on 10% of traffic. No errors in 5m.

Sam (support): Notified affected customers: told them we're applying mitigations and will follow up with root cause.

Elena (eng-ml): For medium term we should add background KV compaction and allocator sweeps; also consider slab allocator tuning (increase slab_reclaim_threshold=0.25). I'll open an RFC.

Mia (eng-runtime): Created issue #RT-4523 with triage notes and links. Next actions: continue canary -> 50% then full, monitor p95/p99 and GPU free lists. Thanks all.
